methodology_notes.overall_score: Official GPI score published by the Institute for Economics & Peace; not recomputed by GIR.
methodology_notes.domain_scores: Official domain scores published in Appendix C; not recomputed by GIR.
methodology_notes.rank_change: Positive means the country moved upward (improved) versus the prior edition; negative means it moved downward.

extraction.normalization: Country labels mapped to ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 where available; Kosovo uses user-assigned XKX.

interpretation.overall_score: Official published IEP value; GIR does not recompute it.
interpretation.rank: Official published rank; lower rank is better.
interpretation.rank_change: Positive means upward movement/improvement versus the previous edition.
interpretation.domain_scores: Official published Appendix C values; lower is better.
